preservation_rule: v1 findings remain valid unless explicitly changed below. This file is a versioned evidence-closure delta, not a rewrite for novelty.

family_validation.judgment: The eight v1 families remain sufficient at mechanism level after the 150-row Beauty/Wellness-heavy continuation. New evidence mostly strengthened boundaries and secondary-family combinations rather than creating a ninth family.

families.name: Sensory Sanctuary / Atmospheric Rest
families.boundary_refinement: Atmosphere qualifies only when sensory/ritual expectation changes the decision; generic beige/natural styling does not.

families.name: Clinical Calm / Structured Reassurance
families.boundary_refinement: Clinical authority can be warm or colorful; the defining mechanism is precise evidence/boundary/process without anxiety-amplifying clutter.

families.name: Editorial High-Consideration / Aspirational Authority
families.boundary_refinement: Editorial scale must persist into a credible proof/commitment handoff; photography alone is insufficient.

families.name: Human Craft / Provenance-Led Intimacy
families.boundary_refinement: Provenance may be temporal, material, editorial or human; it must be specific and inspectable rather than nostalgic styling.

families.name: Guided Choice / Diagnostic Clarity
families.boundary_refinement: The decision sequence/selector is the family mechanism, not a card grid or quiz visual.

families.name: Proof-Led Process Authority
families.boundary_refinement: Proof should be causal and local to the decision; detached claim walls are not equivalent.

families.name: Local Human / Community Warmth
families.boundary_refinement: Real place, people, access and visit feasibility are structural trust inputs; generic friendliness/locality claims are not.

families.name: Category Education / Open Discovery
families.boundary_refinement: Education must precede conversion only when the user lacks a usable category model; otherwise it becomes unnecessary exposition.

family_validation.family_selection_rule: Select dominant family + optional secondary influence from customer state, authority, information density, trust logic, composition and commitment. Never select family from photo/evidence quantity or collection difficulty.

beauty_wellness_taxonomy_validation.reason: Same-industry density is materially stronger across salons, esthetic/treatment, clinic, wellness/body-care, beauty education/support and product contexts. Multi-company Production validation is still required before a selector contract becomes hard-coded.
beauty_wellness_taxonomy_validation.prohibited_shortcut: Do not translate each family into one fixed layout/template.

module_composition_registry_delta.judgment: Continuation evidence refined existing persuasion/composition grammar rather than justifying a generic component explosion.

compatibility_delta.condition: trust-sensitive ambiguous choice; selector/recommendation must be supported by actual evidence
use a deliberate atmosphere→evidence handoff; do not inject dense proof into the sensory opening
real people/place/service context must exist; stock-like editorialization is prohibited
appropriate for devices/wellness where experience matters, but proof must arrive before high commitment

compatibility_delta.combination: Guided Choice + fixed generic card matrix
compatibility_delta.condition: cards may appear, but repeated card geometry cannot substitute for authored decision states
Creative Fit precedes Production Feasibility; adapt realization after family choice

creative_profile_validation.validation_reason: The new same-industry corpus repeatedly changes art direction based on customer decision/trust/authority state, while asset availability changes how the selected direction can be safely realized, not which direction fits.

implementation_boundary: No selector, renderer, HTML/CSS component, numeric resemblance gate, Nagi rebuild or Production engine change is authorized by this research artifact.
